messages:
sanjay: Quick follow-up on RFC #309 — proposal to carve "islands of responsibility" across runtime, KV cache, and session orchestration. Wanted to outline a cutover approach and get concerns.

elaine: Love the name. Can we be explicit about the public interfaces and expected compatibility guarantees? need minimal shims.

maria: Agree. Also we need clear gating metrics before we flip traffic: token p50/p95, tail latency, cache hit-rate, and error budget burn rate.

devin: Main concern: a rolling cutover might double some in-memory structures briefly (KV + shadow cache). How do we mitigate memory spikes?

frank: Suggested 4-phase cutover: 1) deploy thin adapters behind a feature flag, 2) enable shadow writes + read-compare, 3) canary ~10% traffic + monitor, 4) flip and remove old paths. Ownership windows per phase.

elaine: For the "thin adapters" phase we'll need a tiny compatibility surface: read(key) / write(key, ttl). Keep shapes stable.

Tori: Here's a tiny example of the adapter contract we discussed:

```go
// session_adapter.go - minimal shim for cutover
type SessionAdapter interface {
  LoadSession(key string) (*Session, error)
  StoreChunk(key string, chunk []byte) error
}
```

Tori: And config to toggle shadow mode: `islands.mode = "shadow"` / `"active"` / `"off"`.

sanjay: We should also add an automated regression harness: small prompt set + perf runner that runs on canary traffic to detect quality regressions and token blowups.

maria: I'll add a CI job that runs the eval harness and fails the canary if QoR or latency thresholds are missed.

devin: Still want a memory mitigation plan: 1) cap shadow cache size, 2) backpressure on write-path, 3) gradual resource bump with autoscaler. I'll prototype heap profiles.

frank: Dedicated customers: toggles can't be pushed blindly. Plan is manual opt-in for Dedicated; add `islands.cutover = "manual"` in their config and provide migration tooling.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: infra/canary/172345 (placeholder job created).

elaine: :thumbsup: Add dashboard widgets for `adapter_errors`, `migration_lag`, `shadow_delta_ratio` so SRE can watch the delta.

Tori: Edge case: model swap fallback — we need a small compat-layer that translates old KV shapes to new ones for older models until they're migrated.

sanjay: OK — I'll draft a cutover playbook with step-by-step rollback instructions, estimated time per phase, and required owners. Will include the SLO gates and exact metric thresholds.

maria: I'll own the metrics dashboards and the CI eval job.

devin: I'll own memory profiling + a recommended resource bump plan and a short runbook for when memory exceeds X%.

frank: Add a short checklist in the playbook: schema migrations, retention policy updates, throttling policy, and customer comms for Dedicated. Ping @ops for maintenance window.

ops-jen: ops-jen: noted. prefer a weekend low-traffic window + pre-cutover smoke test. I'll sync with SRE.

sanjay: Thanks everyone — I'll post the RFC follow-up doc and the cutover playbook by EOD Fri.
